blocks.zh: ⚠ Key Principle — 核心原則
blocks.en: ⚠ Key Principle

blocks.zh: 設計規格書必須依據已核准的需求產出，並在確效過程中加以驗證。從 URS 到 IQ/OQ 記錄的可追溯性是強制性的。
blocks.en: The design specification must be derived from approved requirements and verified during qualification. Traceability from the URS through to the IQ/OQ records is mandatory.

blocks.zh: Pharma IT — Why Specifications Matter  /  規格書的製藥意義
blocks.en: Pharma IT — Why Specifications Matter

blocks.zh: URS — User Requirement Specification  /  使用者需求規格書
blocks.en: URS — User Requirement Specification

blocks.zh: 以業務、法規和 GxP 需求為核心，可重複使用於同類平台元件
blocks.en: Centered on business, regulatory and GxP requirements; can be reused across similar platform components

blocks.zh: DS — Design Specification  /  設計規格書
blocks.en: DS — Design Specification

blocks.zh: 依核准 FS/URS 產出，描述實際技術實施方式，作為採購與 IQ 依據
blocks.en: Derived from the approved FS/URS; describes the actual technical implementation and serves as the basis for procurement and IQ

blocks.zh: 💡 Real-World Analogy  /  生活比喻
blocks.en: 💡 Real-World Analogy

blocks.zh: 把 URS 想成建築師的需求書（「我們需要 ISO 5 潔淨室」），FS 是建築平面圖，DS 則是工程詳圖，包含精確的管徑與風速參數。
blocks.en: Think of the URS as the architect's brief ("we need an ISO 5 cleanroom"), the FS as the floor plan, and the DS as the detailed engineering drawings, including exact pipe diameters and airflow parameters.

blocks.zh: Template Recommendation  /  建議使用模板
blocks.en: Template Recommendation

blocks.zh: GAMP 建議使用模板收集平台需求，包含來自應用規格的 GxP 相關操作設定，以確保類似基礎設施元件文件的一致性。
blocks.en: GAMP recommends using a template to collect platform requirements, including GxP-relevant operational settings taken from the application specification, to ensure consistent documentation of similar infrastructure components.

blocks.zh: GxP Network Segmentation  /  GxP 網路分段
blocks.en: GxP Network Segmentation

blocks.zh: GxP 法規要求：受 GxP 管制的網路必須與行政網路分隔，以防止未授權存取、保護受管制數據，並確保稽查軌跡完整性。
blocks.en: GxP regulatory requirement: GxP-regulated networks must be segregated from administrative networks to prevent unauthorized access, protect regulated data and ensure audit trail integrity.

blocks.zh: Topology Diagram Contents  /  拓樸圖應包含
blocks.en: Topology Diagram Contents

blocks.zh: 網路拓樸圖就像潔淨室分類圖：標示哪些區域是 ISO Class 5（GxP 關鍵）與 Class 8，以及它們之間的物理邊界。就像訪客不能自由進入灌裝室一樣，行政流量也不能自由進入 GxP 網路區段。
blocks.en: A network topology diagram is like a cleanroom classification plan: it shows which areas are ISO Class 5 (GxP-critical) and which are Class 8, and the physical boundaries between them. Just as visitors cannot walk freely into the filling room, administrative traffic must not pass freely into the GxP network segment.

blocks.zh: SNMP & Managed Networks  /  SNMP 與受管理網路
blocks.en: SNMP & Managed Networks

blocks.zh: SNMP 讓網路成為「受管理網路」，支援對網路設備特性、安裝狀態及設定的電腦輔助追蹤，是長期維護 IQ 記錄的關鍵。
blocks.en: SNMP makes the network a "managed network", supporting computer-assisted tracking of network device characteristics, installation status and configuration, which is key to maintaining IQ records over the long term.

blocks.zh:
A manufacturing site connects its MES (Manufacturing Execution System) to both the plant floor network and the corporate IT network. What network design controls should be in place, and what must be documented in the topology diagram?
製造現場的 MES 連接廠區網路和企業 IT 網路，應有哪些網路設計控制措施，且拓樸圖中必須記錄哪些內容？
blocks.en: A manufacturing site connects its MES (Manufacturing Execution System) to both the plant floor network and the corporate IT network. What network design controls should be in place, and what must be documented in the topology diagram?

blocks.zh: Why System Time Is a GxP Critical Parameter  /  系統時間為何是 GxP 關鍵參數
blocks.en: Why System Time Is a GxP Critical Parameter

blocks.zh: 21 CFR Part 11 與 EU Annex 11 要求電子記錄包含準確可靠的日期/時間戳記。時間錯誤的伺服器可能使批次記錄、稽查軌跡和電子簽名失效。FDA 稽查員會定期檢查 NTP 設定和時間同步記錄。
blocks.en: 21 CFR Part 11 and EU Annex 11 require electronic records to contain accurate and reliable date/time stamps. A server with the wrong time can invalidate batch records, audit trails and electronic signatures. FDA inspectors routinely check NTP settings and time synchronization records.

blocks.zh: Configuration Items List (CIL)  /  組態項目清單
blocks.en: Configuration Items List (CIL)

blocks.zh: 💡 The "Drug Master File" of IT  /  IT 的藥物主檔案
blocks.en: 💡 The "Drug Master File" of IT

blocks.zh: 伺服器的 CIL 就像製藥原料的藥物主檔案（DMF）——精確記錄伺服器的所有「組成」，使其可以完全相同地重建。CIL 讓您的團隊能夠將伺服器重建或複製到完全相同的驗證過組態。
blocks.en: A server's CIL is like a Drug Master File (DMF) for a pharmaceutical raw material: it records everything the server is "made of" precisely enough that it can be rebuilt identically. The CIL lets your team rebuild or replicate a server to exactly the same validated configuration.

blocks.zh: Peripheral Equipment  /  周邊設備
blocks.en: Peripheral Equipment

blocks.zh: 周邊設備通常是具有嵌入式韌體的標準化商業現成品，應用規格不應偏離預設設定，除非有具體要求、理由與文件記錄。
blocks.en: Peripheral equipment is typically standardized commercial off-the-shelf product with embedded firmware. The application specification should not deviate from default settings unless there is a specific requirement, a justification and documentation.

blocks.zh:

您的已驗證 Windows Server 2022 主機執行 GxP 批次記錄應用程式，OS 安裝時預設時區為 UTC，但現場在 UTC+8（台灣）。需要哪些規格書和 IQ 行動？
blocks.en: Your validated Windows Server 2022 hosts a GxP batch record application. The OS was installed with the manufacturer default time zone (UTC). The local site operates in UTC+8 (Taiwan). What specification and IQ actions are required?

blocks.zh: Image-Based Deployment  /  映像部署策略
blocks.en: Image-Based Deployment

blocks.zh: 為了最大化控制和效率，GAMP 建議準備並維護已驗證的客戶端映像或安裝腳本，在透過集中式分發進行大規模部署前，先在單一標準客戶端實例上測試。
blocks.en: To maximize control and efficiency, GAMP recommends preparing and maintaining a validated client image or installation script, and testing it on a single standard client instance before large-scale deployment through centralized distribution.

blocks.zh: GxP Client — Special Controls  /  GxP 客戶端特殊控制
blocks.en: GxP Client — Special Controls

blocks.zh: 💡 Data Center as a "GMP Suite"  /  資料中心是「GMP 套間」
blocks.en: 💡 Data Center as a "GMP Suite"

blocks.zh: 把資料中心想成無菌製造套間：兩者都需要受控存取（穿衣間 = 門禁 + 生物辨識）、環境監控（溫度/濕度 = 冷卻 + UPS）、與外部污染的隔離（氣閘 = 防火牆），以及記錄進出和操作的稽查軌跡。
blocks.en: Think of a data center as a sterile manufacturing suite: both need controlled access (gowning room = access control + biometrics), environmental monitoring (temperature/humidity = cooling + UPS), isolation from external contamination (airlock = firewall), and an audit trail recording entry and operations.

blocks.zh: Dual/Triple Data Centers  /  雙/三重資料中心
blocks.en: Dual/Triple Data Centers

blocks.zh: 部分公司選擇建立雙重或三重資料中心以確保可用性，支援業務持續計畫（BCP）和災難恢復（DR）需求，對於數據損失可能影響產品品質和患者安全的 GxP 系統尤為重要。
blocks.en: Some companies choose dual or triple data centers to ensure availability and to support business continuity planning (BCP) and disaster recovery (DR) needs. This is especially important for GxP systems where data loss could affect product quality and patient safety.

blocks.zh:
A QC analyst's workstation runs both a validated chromatography data system (CDS) and an unrestricted web browser. What client classification should apply, and how should the workstation be managed?
QC 分析師的工作站同時執行已驗證的色譜數據系統（CDS）和不受限制的網頁瀏覽器，應適用哪種客戶端分類？應如何管理？
blocks.en: A QC analyst's workstation runs both a validated chromatography data system (CDS) and an unrestricted web browser. What client classification should apply, and how should the workstation be managed?

您的資料中心使用網路漏洞掃描工具，在 GxP 基礎設施上使用此工具之前必須驗證哪三件事？
blocks.en: Your data center uses a network vulnerability scanning tool. What three things must be verified before using this tool on GxP infrastructure?

blocks.zh: 風險評估與確效測試規劃 | GAMP-Based Approach to Qualification Scope
blocks.en: Risk Assessment and Qualification Test Planning | GAMP-Based Approach to Qualification Scope

blocks.zh: Risk Assessment Process  /  風險評估流程
blocks.en: Risk Assessment Process

blocks.zh:
"A benefit of using pre-qualified building blocks with standard qualification packages is that following the initial qualification only subsequent changes need be assessed for impact and risk."

「使用具有標準確效套件的預先確效建構模塊的好處是，初始確效完成後，只需評估後續變更的影響和風險。」
blocks.en:
"A benefit of using pre-qualified building blocks with standard qualification packages is that following the initial qualification only subsequent changes need be assessed for impact and risk."

"A benefit of using pre-qualified building blocks with standard qualification packages is that, following the initial qualification, only subsequent changes need to be assessed for impact and risk."

blocks.zh: GAMP Category-Based Test Planning  /  GAMP 類別測試規劃
blocks.en: GAMP Category-Based Test Planning

blocks.zh: Building Block Qualification Strategy  /  建構模塊確效策略
blocks.en: Building Block Qualification Strategy

blocks.zh: 一旦建構模塊（如標準 Windows Server 2022 映像）完成確效，後續複製品的確效重點僅在於驗證複製是否正確產生，大幅降低相同後續部署的測試負擔。
blocks.en: Once a building block (such as a standard Windows Server 2022 image) has been qualified, qualification of subsequent copies focuses only on verifying that the copy was produced correctly, greatly reducing the testing burden for identical later deployments.

blocks.zh: Risk Assessment Outputs  /  風險評估產出
blocks.en: Risk Assessment Outputs

blocks.zh: 💡 Risk = Probability × Impact  /  風險 = 機率 × 影響
blocks.en: 💡 Risk = Probability × Impact

blocks.zh: 在製程驗證中，我們不會平等測試所有參數，而是將測試工作集中在最直接影響關鍵品質屬性（CQA）的關鍵製程參數（CPP）上。IT 基礎設施同理：風險評估識別最需要嚴格確效測試的「IT CPP」（如 NTP 同步、存取控制、稽查軌跡設定）。
blocks.en: In process validation, we do not test all parameters equally; we concentrate testing effort on the critical process parameters (CPPs) that most directly affect critical quality attributes (CQAs). The same applies to IT infrastructure: the risk assessment identifies the "IT CPPs" that need the most rigorous qualification testing (such as NTP synchronization, access control and audit trail settings).

blocks.zh:
You are installing 50 identical network switches across a production facility. All are the same model, firmware version, and configuration template. How does the building block concept change your qualification approach?
您在生產設施中安裝 50 台相同的網路交換器，型號、韌體版本和設定模板均相同。建構模塊概念如何改變您的確效方法？
blocks.en: You are installing 50 identical network switches across a production facility. All are the same model, firmware version, and configuration template. How does the building block concept change your qualification approach?

blocks.zh:
What documentation must be produced as an output of the risk assessment phase before proceeding to test scripting?
在進入測試腳本編寫之前，風險評估階段必須產出哪些文件？
blocks.en: What documentation must be produced as an output of the risk assessment phase before proceeding to test scripting?

blocks.zh:
A monitoring tool automatically checks server performance every 5 minutes and logs to a database. Does this tool need to be qualified? What risk factors should guide your decision?
一個監控工具每 5 分鐘自動檢查伺服器效能並記錄到資料庫，此工具是否需要被確效？哪些風險因素應指導您的決定？
blocks.en: A monitoring tool automatically checks server performance every 5 minutes and logs to a database. Does this tool need to be qualified? What risk factors should guide your decision?

blocks.zh: GAMP Testing Category Decision Table  /  GAMP 測試類別決策表
blocks.en: GAMP Testing Category Decision Table

blocks.zh: ⚠ How to Use This Table  /  如何使用本表
blocks.en: ⚠ How to Use This Table

blocks.zh: 本決策表僅為指導方針，實際分類必須由您現場的風險評估決定。單一元件的不同參數可能需要不同的測試等級（如路由器的實體安裝 = 確認測試；其 GxP 網路分段設定 = 信心測試或完整測試）。務必記錄選擇測試等級的理由。
blocks.en: This decision table is guidance only; the actual classification must be determined by the risk assessment at your site. Different parameters of a single component may need different test levels (for example, the physical installation of a router = verification testing; its GxP network segmentation settings = confidence testing or full testing). Always document the rationale for the test level selected.

blocks.zh: 採購與供應商評估 | Approved / Conditionally Approved / Not Approved
blocks.en: Procurement and Supplier Evaluation | Approved / Conditionally Approved / Not Approved

blocks.zh: Procurement Principles  /  採購原則
blocks.en: Procurement Principles

blocks.zh: Supplier Classification  /  供應商分類
blocks.en: Supplier Classification

blocks.zh: ✅ Approved  /  核准
blocks.en: ✅ Approved

blocks.zh: 交貨記錄或收集的資訊令人滿意。注意：初次稽查後不一定立即給予此分類，因為往往有需要糾正的問題，視問題情況而定，這種情況不一定是問題。
blocks.en: Delivery records or the information collected are satisfactory. Note: this classification is not necessarily given immediately after the first audit, because there are often issues to be corrected; depending on the circumstances, this is not necessarily a problem.

blocks.zh: ⚠ Conditionally Approved  /  有條件核准
blocks.en: ⚠ Conditionally Approved

blocks.zh: 交貨記錄或收集的資訊未完全令人滿意，緩解措施可能包括更密切的後續追蹤、更密集的測試和見證。
blocks.en: Delivery records or the information collected are not fully satisfactory. Mitigation may include closer follow-up, more intensive testing and witnessing.

blocks.zh: ❌ Not Approved  /  未核准
blocks.en: ❌ Not Approved

blocks.zh: 資訊或交貨記錄不足或不令人滿意，在解決問題之前不允許從此供應商採購 GxP 相關物品。
blocks.en: Information or delivery records are insufficient or unsatisfactory. Procurement of GxP-relevant items from this supplier is not permitted until the issues are resolved.

blocks.zh: Supplier Assessment in Pharma IT Practice  /  製藥 IT 供應商評估實務
blocks.en: Supplier Assessment in Pharma IT Practice

blocks.zh: COTS vs. Custom Procurement Strategy  /  COTS 與訂製採購策略
blocks.en: COTS vs. Custom Procurement Strategy

blocks.zh: COTS（商業現成品）：標準基礎設施元件的首選。由於供應商認證、測試證據和市場歷史均可取得，供應商評估負擔較低。
blocks.en: COTS (commercial off-the-shelf): The preferred choice for standard infrastructure components. The supplier assessment burden is lower because supplier certifications, test evidence and market history are available.

blocks.zh: 訂製品：需要更高的供應商評估要求，強烈建議進行出廠驗收測試（FAT）。
blocks.en: Custom products: Require more demanding supplier assessment, and a factory acceptance test (FAT) is strongly recommended.

blocks.zh: Supplier Assessment Criteria  /  供應商評估標準
blocks.en: Supplier Assessment Criteria

blocks.zh: 認定 GxP IT 供應商類似於認定 API 製造商：不只是購買使用，而是稽查其設施、審查品質系統、檢查批次記錄（等同於測試報告），並在首次使用前核准。對 IT 供應商而言，「設施」= 其開發和支援流程；「批次記錄」= 軟體開發文件和測試證據。
blocks.en: Qualifying a GxP IT supplier is similar to qualifying an API manufacturer: you do not simply buy and use; you audit their facilities, review their quality system, examine their batch records (equivalent to test reports) and approve them before first use. For an IT supplier, the "facility" = their development and support processes, and the "batch record" = software development documentation and test evidence.

blocks.zh: Factory Acceptance Test (FAT)  /  出廠驗收測試
blocks.en: Factory Acceptance Test (FAT)

blocks.zh: Building Block IQ Efficiency  /  建構模塊 IQ 效率
blocks.en: Building Block IQ Efficiency

blocks.zh: 建構模塊概念最大化確效效率。一旦建構模塊完成確效，後續部署的 IQ 重點僅是驗證複製品是否正確產生。
blocks.en: The building block concept maximizes qualification efficiency. Once a building block has been qualified, the IQ focus for subsequent deployments is only to verify that the copy was produced correctly.

blocks.zh: IQ Documentation Package  /  IQ 文件套件
blocks.en: IQ Documentation Package

blocks.zh: Application Connectivity Testing — OUT OF SCOPE at IQ  /  應用程式連線測試不在 IQ 範圍內
blocks.en: Application Connectivity Testing — OUT OF SCOPE at IQ

blocks.zh: 應用程式連線測試不在基礎設施 IQ 的範圍內，在系統驗證工作（OQ/PQ）中驗證。在基礎設施正式移交完成之前，不得開始應用程式測試。
blocks.en: Application connectivity testing is outside the scope of infrastructure IQ and is verified in the system validation work (OQ/PQ). Application testing must not begin until the formal handover of the infrastructure is complete.

blocks.zh: 💡 IQ = "New Cleanroom Commissioning"  /  IQ = 「新潔淨室試運行」
blocks.en: 💡 IQ = "New Cleanroom Commissioning"

blocks.zh: 伺服器的 IQ 就像潔淨室試運行：驗證物理結構是否按照規格建造（尺寸、材料）、環境系統是否安裝並正常運行（HVAC、排水），以及所有必要文件是否到位 — 在引入產品或執行任何製程之前。您正在根據「設計狀態」驗證「建造狀態」。
blocks.en: A server IQ is like cleanroom commissioning: you verify that the physical structure was built to specification (dimensions, materials), that environmental systems are installed and functioning (HVAC, drainage), and that all required documentation is in place, before any product is introduced or any process is run. You are verifying the "as-built state" against the "design state".

blocks.en: During an IQ for a new VMware ESXi cluster, you find that the server room temperature sensor shows 28°C (design spec: max 24°C). The equipment is not yet powered on. What is your immediate action and what IQ documentation is required?

blocks.en: The application team wants to start user acceptance testing (UAT) immediately after hardware installation is complete, while IQ documentation is still being finalized. Is this acceptable? What is the correct sequence?

blocks.zh: 本節摘要與關鍵要點 | Chapters 5.4–5.6
blocks.en: Section Summary and Key Takeaways | Chapters 5.4–5.6

blocks.zh: 核心要點 — 中文摘要
blocks.en: Key Points — Commentary Summary

blocks.zh: 5.4 規格書與設計
blocks.en: 5.4 Specifications and Design

blocks.zh: 規格書層級：URS → FS → DS → CIL，全程可追溯至 IQ/OQ 記錄
blocks.en: Specification hierarchy: URS → FS → DS → CIL, with full traceability to the IQ/OQ records

blocks.zh: 網路：拓樸圖為必要文件；GxP 網路分段是強制要求；SNMP 用於受管理網路
blocks.en: Networks: the topology diagram is a required document; GxP network segmentation is mandatory; SNMP is used for managed networks

blocks.zh: 伺服器：硬體 CIL + 軟體 CIL 為必要；OS 參數類別 1/2/3 決定文件範圍
blocks.en: Servers: hardware CIL + software CIL are required; OS parameter categories 1/2/3 determine the scope of documentation

blocks.zh: 系統時間：可追溯至 UTC；於 IQ 和 OQ 驗證；責任人必須文件化
blocks.en: System time: traceable to UTC; verified at IQ and OQ; the responsible person must be documented

blocks.zh: 儲存：SAN vs. NAS 依負載和拓樸決定；OQ 必須透過連接的伺服器進行
blocks.en: Storage: SAN vs. NAS is chosen according to workload and topology; OQ must be performed through the connected servers

blocks.zh: 客戶端：三層分類（非限制/限制/受控）；GxP 客戶端採用映像式部署
blocks.en: Clients: three-tier classification (unrestricted / restricted / controlled); image-based deployment for GxP clients

blocks.zh: 資料中心：UPS、冷卻、實體安全、消防保護均須規格書規定並驗證
blocks.en: Data centers: UPS, cooling, physical security and fire protection must all be specified and verified

blocks.zh: 5.5 風險評估與測試規劃
blocks.en: 5.5 Risk Assessment and Test Planning

blocks.zh: 迭代流程：從規劃開始，隨設計完成而細化
blocks.en: Iterative process: starts with planning and is refined as the design is completed

blocks.zh: GAMP 類別決定測試等級：不需測試 → 確認測試 → 信心測試 → 完整測試
blocks.en: GAMP category determines the test level: no testing → verification testing → confidence testing → full testing

blocks.zh: 建構模塊：一次確效，後續驗證複製 — 最大化效率
blocks.en: Building blocks: qualify once, then verify the copies afterwards, to maximize efficiency

blocks.zh: 風險評估產出：關鍵元件清單、供應商評估等級、測試範圍、QA 參與、培訓需求、SOP 變更
blocks.en: Risk assessment outputs: critical component list, supplier assessment rating, test scope, QA involvement, training needs, SOP changes

blocks.zh: 5.6 採購、安裝與 IQ
blocks.en: 5.6 Procurement, Installation and IQ

blocks.zh: 供應商分類：核准 / 有條件核准 / 未核准；GxP 物品僅從核准供應商採購
blocks.en: Supplier classification: Approved / Conditionally Approved / Not Approved; GxP items are purchased only from approved suppliers

blocks.zh: FAT 選項：在供應商廠房驗證後再運送，在工廠修復問題更便宜
blocks.en: FAT option: verify at the supplier's site before shipment, since fixing problems at the factory is cheaper

blocks.zh: IQ 範圍：文件驗證 + 環境條件 + 伺服器/OS/網路設定驗證
blocks.en: IQ scope: documentation verification + environmental conditions + server/OS/network configuration verification

blocks.zh: IQ 文件：CIL、拓樸圖、纜線測試報告、環境記錄、供應商證書
blocks.en: IQ documentation: CIL, topology diagram, cable test reports, environmental records, supplier certificates

blocks.zh: 應用程式測試：在正式基礎設施移交前不得進行；必須等待 IQ 簽署完成
blocks.en: Application testing: must not take place before formal infrastructure handover; it must wait until IQ sign-off is complete

blocks.zh: CIL 支援後續已驗證部署的高效伺服器/客戶端複製
blocks.en: The CIL supports efficient replication of servers/clients for later validated deployments

blocks.zh: IT 確效就像拼圖：URS 定義完成後的圖像（患者安全 + 產品品質）；FS 和 DS 定義拼圖片的形狀；風險評估決定哪些片需要單獨驗證；IQ 確認每片都在正確位置；OQ 和 PQ 確認完成的圖像真的有效。沒有完整的 IQ 層，就無法可靠地在其上建立 OQ 和 PQ 層。
blocks.en: IT qualification is like a jigsaw puzzle: the URS defines the finished picture (patient safety + product quality); the FS and DS define the shape of the pieces; the risk assessment decides which pieces need to be verified individually; IQ confirms that every piece is in the right place; OQ and PQ confirm that the completed picture actually works. Without a complete IQ layer, the OQ and PQ layers cannot be built on it reliably.
